title: Redstrike Consolidated Findings
description: The reporting skill's consolidated findings artifact. Two accepted shapes: a bare array of findings, or a report object wrapping findings[] (plus an optional composite attack_chains[]) alongside header fields. Each entry in findings[]/attack_chains[] follows the single-finding shape in finding.schema.json; this schema validates the top-level envelope only — per-finding conformance is enforced against finding.schema.json by the engagement gate (verify_completion.py).
